main.paragraph2: I am currently focusing on programming in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, and C#. I have experience with frameworks such as Nuxt.js and Vue.js. I love learning new technologies and working on engaging projects.

lang.header: Programming Languages, Technologies, and Tools I use

Projects.paragraph: A selection of projects I've built.
Projects.paragraphFull: These are the projects I have created. Some are school assignments, while others are personal projects I've worked on in my free time. All of them were built with the goal of improving my programming skills and gaining experience with various technologies.

racing_sim.title: Motorsport Manager
racing_sim.description: Motorsport Manager is a Formula 1 simulator developed using Nuxt.js and SQLite. It is a game that currently runs on localhost.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: This website is built on Nuxt.js and Vue.js. It showcases my projects, skills, and programming experience. I am also using this project to learn TypeScript.

shimmer.title: The Shimmer
shimmer.description: The Shimmer is a 2D platformer created in Unity. It is an RPG/JRPG school project for Creative Hill College, inspired by the movie Annihilation.

str.title: Scan The Result
str.description: Scan The Result is a tool for storing and evaluating results from SETA sporting targets. It was one of my first projects; I am not currently active on it, but I plan to rewrite it in other languages in the future.

Old_portfolio.title: Old Portfolio
Old_portfolio.description: This is the first version of my portfolio, created as a school project. It is built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Biathlon_Game.title: Biathlon Game
Biathlon_Game.description: A simple 3D game created in Unity as part of my school admission process. Based on biathlon, players must shoot targets while navigating the track. It was my very first project in this engine.

Contact.paragraph: I'd be happy to hear from you for any reason. Whether you have an interesting project we could work on together or just want to connect, feel free to reach out.

about.label: About Me
about.heading: Who am I?
about.intro: I am a programmer and a student at Creative Hill College in Zlín. I primarily focus on web technologies and software development. I have experience with frameworks like Nuxt.js and Vue.js, and I'm always learning new things through hands-on projects. Here is my story.

t2.title: Gamer
t2.desc: As a kid, I fell in love with games and always wanted to create one exactly how I imagined it. I started with Scratch but always aspired to work in a professional engine.

t3.title: My first Unity game and school choice
t3.desc: I started learning Unity and used my game as an admission project for Creative Hill College. I even built a website for it. You can find it in the projects section as 'Biathlon Game' – it's a project about a sport I love.

t4.title: High School – IT Major
t4.desc: I started at Creative Hill College in Zlín, where I first encountered languages like Python and JavaScript. In my first year, I built my first portfolio. I later used these skills during the summer for the 'Scan The Result' project. I also began learning tools like Photoshop and Illustrator.

t5.title: 2nd Year at Creative Hill College
t5.desc: During my second year, we were tasked with creating a web application. This led me to the Nuxt.js framework, which I continue to master. I've also started learning Java and SQL while further developing my JavaScript skills. Currently, I'm working on a Unity game and exploring more web tools and databases.
